justification: The clearest shared depicted content is only generic-to-moderately specific: both surfaces include schematic incised curving lines, roundel-like forms, and some parallel banding. The major difference is that B is organized as a frontal anthropomorphic figure with head, shoulders/arms, chest motifs and belt-like arcs, while A appears as a fragmentary vertical field or border of abstract/possibly zoomorphic signs without the same figure scheme or element relationships.
